name: Ovarian Tumours: Surface Epithelial, Germ Cell and Sex Cord

reference.source: Robbins Basic Pathology 9th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: AFP Duval: yolk sac; hCG bleed: chorio
Fibroma fluid cured by removal: Meigs
reference.pathophysiology: Fimbrial STIC sheds p53 clones across peritoneum while yolk sac endoderm secretes AFP; granulosa aromatase hyperplasias endometrium, and fibromatous transudation fills pleura reversibly.
additionalDifferentials: High versus low grade serous by p53 and BRCA
Mucinous ovarian versus appendiceal by CK7 and CK20
Dysgerminoma versus lymphoma by PLAP and markers
additionalInvestigations: CA-125 with ROMA and transvaginal ultrasound in adnexal mass
AFP, hCG and LDH in young solid ovarian mass
Inhibin with endometrial sampling in granulosa
